Architecture (--arch)
How the project's packages are laid out and wired together.

  mvc             Model-View-Controller
                  Models, controllers, and a data store in separate packages, wired together in cmd/<name>.
  vertical-slice  Vertical slice
                  One directory per feature, holding its types, HTTP handlers, and data access; shared infrastructure in internal/platform.

HTTP framework (--framework)
Routes HTTP requests to handlers.

  chi      chi
           The lightweight, idiomatic chi router, compatible with net/http handlers and middleware.
  gin      Gin
           The Gin web framework, with its fast router and gin.Context handlers.
  nethttp  net/http
           The standard library HTTP server and its pattern-based ServeMux.

Database (--db)
Where the project stores its data.

  postgres  PostgreSQL
            PostgreSQL through pgx, a pure-Go driver, used with database/sql.
            provides: conn=database/sql, sql-dialect=postgresql, sql-schema=schema.sql
  sqlite    SQLite
            SQLite through modernc.org/sqlite, a pure-Go driver that needs no cgo.
            provides: conn=database/sql, sql-dialect=sqlite, sql-schema=schema.sql

Data access (--data)
How the code reads and writes the database.

  gorm  GORM
        Data access through the GORM ORM, on the database's own connection and schema.
        requires: conn=database/sql, sql-dialect=sqlite|postgresql, sql-schema=schema.sql
  sqlc  sqlc
        Type-safe Go code generated from SQL queries by sqlc.
        requires: conn=database/sql, sql-dialect=sqlite|postgresql, sql-schema=schema.sql

Frontend (--frontend, optional)
Web pages served next to the API, which then moves under /api.

  none  No frontend (the default)
  htmx  htmx + templ
        Server-rendered pages written as templ components, made interactive with htmx, and served by the Go binary with no build step.
